title: Broad website and cookie access
explanation: This combination could expose authenticated activity across many websites if the extension were compromised.

title: Broad request modification
explanation: This combination can modify traffic across nearly every website.

title: Downloads connected to desktop software
explanation: This combination bridges browser downloads with an application running outside Firefox.

title: Broad website and clipboard access
explanation: This combination can observe web content and copied data.

title: Traffic routing and observation
explanation: This combination can route browser traffic and observe requests.

title: Broad activity visibility
explanation: This combination reveals both current website access and historical browsing activity.
